0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 10th in the West, 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, with a win in their most recent game) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest) for the Suns' third game of the 2026-27 season. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery, and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery). The Suns lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-3 and were swept 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their most recent meeting was a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
